intent: Record as reviewed the search ranking, fallback, paging, query and filter rules the catalog Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context catalog lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A hybrid candidate farther than the cosine distance cutoff is dropped unless the lexical leg covered it or it has no vector.
Hybrid results are ordered exact name first, then lexically covered, then vector-ranked by nearest distance, with unranked last and the skill id as the final tiebreak.
When embeddings are missing or fail, search returns the lexical results and says it is degraded, rather than failing the request.
The search limit must be a whole number from 1 to 100; anything else is refused.
A search query longer than 2000 characters, counted in runes, is refused; exactly 2000 is accepted.
Search fetches one row past the limit; when more than the limit match, it returns the limit, marks the page truncated and reports the full total.
A search made for reference records no search_performed analytics event.
A filter given with an empty value is refused rather than treated as absent.
A query is searched only when it is valid text without control characters, has at least two characters and holds a letter or digit.
